limitations: Only nonnegative unimodal real sequences on finite unweighted paths, centered counting-measure balls, and edge 1-variation. The arbitrary-input path conjecture and weighted or other-graph versions remain open.
scientific_integrity: The peak-preservation argument and endpoint bounds are analytic. Exact finite-rational tests corroborate but do not establish the theorem; no independent audit or exhaustive literature coverage is claimed.
title: A sharp peak-location variation bound for centered maximal averages on finite paths
